name.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ
name.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets

note.ja: Legendreの3項漸化式からGauss節点と重みを構成し、2n−1次までの多項式モーメントと指数関数を検査します。適応Simpsonは指数関数とLorentz型ピークを積分し、解析積分・独立QUADPACKと比較します。
note.en: Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK.

name.ja: 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点
name.en: Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots

note.ja: Gauss次数と適応公差を走査し、狭いLorentzピーク、平方根端点、巨大な相殺、零積分、見逃すcompact bumpを解析積分とQUADPACKで検証します。
note.en: Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK.

name.en: QUADPACK dispatch and finite Simpson companions

note.ja: 15本の特殊化求積と15本のSimpson対照を固定入力で比較します。
note.en: Fifteen specialized quadratures and fifteen Simpson companions use fixed inputs.

note.ja: 9本の適応GKと24本の固定DE和を比較します。
note.en: Nine adaptive GK rows and twenty-four fixed DE sums are compared.

name.en: Tensor and Smolyak controls in two to four dimensions

note.ja: 滑らかな積と相互作用積の42本の固定cubatureを比較します。
note.en: Forty-two fixed cubatures compare a smooth product and an interaction product.
